rules.meaning: State that standard returns require an unused item within 30 days of purchase with a receipt.
State that the purchase date or purchase age is unknown.
State that standard eligibility cannot yet be determined.
Ask for the purchase date.
Ask whether the item is unused.
Ask only whether the customer has a receipt.
Do not claim the case is late or outside the window when purchase timing is unknown.
Do not claim the case is within the window when purchase timing is unknown.
Do not claim any refund, transfer, escalation, ticket, or contact action was or will be performed.
Do not state that a refund or return has been approved, processed, or guaranteed.
Do not request passwords or full card numbers.
Do not request receipt contents, copies, photos, scans, numbers, proof, or uploads.
State that at least one identified standard condition is not met.
State that the receipt condition for a standard return is not met.
State that the case requires human review.
Do not replace a known receipt or item-condition failure with an unsupported time failure.
State that the damaged item is a reason for human review.
State that the mentioned interval does not establish the purchase date or purchase age.
Tell the customer not to share passwords or full card numbers.
State that this assistant cannot issue refunds, change decisions, forward requests, or contact people.
State that the known purchase age is within the 30-day standard window.
State that the supplied facts meet the standard return conditions, without approving a refund.
State that the known purchase age is outside the 30-day standard window.
